summary: Sixth and final wake of the day, 1h19m to close. No trades: bankroll $9,967.60 (-0.32%), book unchanged since 8/17 at 94.29% gross across SPY/RSP/IJH/IWM, and every rule re-derived from source came back clear (tilt tracker -16.7bps vs a -600bps trigger, HY over IG by 32bps, breaker $9,336.30 with 633bps of room, RSP cap binding first at +2.22%). Rule 8 produced no candidate: the afternoon tape is price-target lines and a third undated Canada tariff headline, and Wednesday's PCE/NVDA is where the rule gets its real test. The one substantive finding was a self-correction: I verified via /v2/assets that all four legs are fractionable, so the cash-sleeve slack I have called 'unreachable in whole shares' for two weeks was always reachable by notional order -- I still decline to deploy it (worth ~5bps and it spends my entire buffer under the 95% ceiling), but the recited premise came out of the per-run checklist.
